title: Invoice Schema v1
description: Canonical invoice schema defining the shared contract between Capture, invoices service, Orchestrator, agents, and UI.

identity.title: Identity
identity.description: Immutable invoice identity. Once created, these fields cannot change.

invoice_id.title: Invoice ID (RECNO)
invoice_id.description: Sequential, numeric, human-readable ID generated by the AP system. Immutable.

trace_id.title: Trace ID
trace_id.description: Unique trace identifier for auditing and debugging. Immutable.

source.title: Source
source.description: Immutable metadata about where the invoice originated.

system.title: Source System
system.description: The system that created this invoice.

source_invoice_ref.title: Source Invoice Reference
source_invoice_ref.description: Optional reference to the invoice in the source system.

received_at.title: Received At
received_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the invoice was received.

document.title: Document
document.description: Reference to the invoice document image and raw payload. Required only when status = RECEIVED.

image_url.title: Image URL
image_url.description: URL to the invoice document image.

raw_payload_ref.title: Raw Payload Reference
raw_payload_ref.description: Optional reference to the raw payload storage location.

header.title: Header
header.description: Invoice header metadata. Required only when status = RECEIVED.

invoice_date.title: Invoice Date
invoice_date.description: Invoice issue date in ISO format.

vendor_name.title: Vendor Name
vendor_name.description: Name of the vendor issuing the invoice.

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: Invoice line items. Required only when status = RECEIVED, and must contain at least one entry.

line_amount.title: Line Amount
line_amount.description: Total amount for this line item.

status.title: Status
status.description: Current processing status of the invoice.

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.description: System-managed workflow tracking. Records the processing steps through agents and orchestration.

steps.title: Workflow Steps
steps.description: Sequential workflow steps executed by agents or system.

agent.title: Agent
agent.description: Name of the agent or system component that executed this step.

action.title: Action
action.description: Action performed in this workflow step.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this step was executed.

audit.title: Audit
audit.description: Audit trail with creation and update timestamps.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the invoice was created.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the invoice was last updated.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: Optional future-safe extensions for AI, analytics, or custom data. Does not pollute core schema.

then.description: DRAFT status: Minimal invoice created by Capture POST. Only identity, source, status, and audit required.

lines.description: Lines must contain at least one entry when status = RECEIVED

then.description: RECEIVED status: Full invoice submitted via Capture PUT. Document, header, and lines with minimum 1 entry are required.
